Introduction

Welcome to the VTStack API Reference. Our platform provides enterprise-grade infrastructure for Virtual Account Management, specifically optimized for small businesses and digital top-up platforms.

With VTStack, you can programmatically create dedicated virtual bank accounts through our partner PalmPay, enabling instant wallet funding and real-time transaction notifications.

Developer-First Infrastructure

Our APIs are built by engineers, for engineers. We handle the complex banking integration so you can focus on building your product.

The Integration Path

Follow these 5 steps to go from zero to live transactions on VTStack. Each step is designed to ensure maximum security and reliability.

01

Authentication & Identification

Generate your API keys in the Developer dashboard. Use x-api-key for standard requests.

Example Request
// Header for all requests
x-api-key: sk_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx
02

Provision Virtual Accounts

Create dedicated PalmPay accounts for your users. Each account acts as a permanent funding source.

POST/virtual-accounts
curl -X POST https://api.vtstack.ng/api/virtual-accounts \
    -H "x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY" \
    -d '{
        "firstName": "Hassan",
        "lastName": "Ibrahim",
        "email": "hassan@example.com",
        "phone": "08012345678",
        "bvn": "22123456789",
        "reference": "user_102_fund_acc"
    }'
03

Setup Webhooks

Configuring a Webhook URL is mandatory to receive real-time funding notifications.

Example Request
// Example Webhook Response (POST)
{
  "event": "transaction.deposit",
  "data": {
    "accountNumber": "8102345678",
    "amount": 5000,
    "reference": "VT-DEP-721",
    "status": "success"
  }
}
04

Name Enquiry (Verification)

Before sending money out, always verify the recipient's bank details to avoid lost funds.

GET/banks/verify?bankCode=044&accountNumber=0123456789
// Returns verified account name
{
  "success": true,
  "data": { "accountName": "HASSAN IBRAHIM" }
}
Security

Authentication

All API requests require a secret key to be included in the header of your request. Your secret keys allow access to your account sensitive operations, so keep them secure.

Example Request
// Use the x-api-key header for all requests
x-api-key: YOUR_SECRET_KEY

Protect your Secret Key

Never expose your secret keys in frontend code, mobile apps, or public repositories. Use server-side variables to store them.

Base URL

All API requests should be made to the following base URL:

Example Request
https://api.vtstack.ng/api

Standard APIs use the base path, while Secure Payouts use the /v1 prefix as shown in the examples.

Endpoints

POST

Create Virtual Account

Creates a new dedicated virtual bank account (PalmPay) for your customer.

ParameterTypeDescription
firstNamestring (Req)Standard first name (Matches BVN record).
lastNamestring (Req)Standard last name (Matches BVN record).
emailstring (Req)Unique email address for the customer.
bvnstring (Req)11-digit BVN for identity verification.
referencestringYour unique internal customer/transaction ID.
POST/virtual-accounts
{
  "firstName": "Hassan",
  "lastName": "Ibrahim",
  "email": "hassan@example.com",
  "phone": "08012345678",
  "bvn": "22123456789",
  "reference": "user_id_102"
}
GET

Fetch Virtual Accounts

Returns a paginated list of all virtual accounts associated with your platform.

GET/virtual-accounts
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "accountNumber": "8102345678",
      "accountName": "Hassan Ibrahim",
      "bankName": "PalmPay",
      "status": "active"
    }
  ]
}

Bank Verification

Use VTStack's Bank Verification API to resolve and verify bank account details before initiating payouts. This helps prevent failed transfers by confirming the account holder's name and validating the account number against the bank.

Why Verify?

Always verify a bank account before sending money. This prevents sending funds to the wrong recipient and reduces dispute and chargeback risks. Verification is instant and powered by PalmPay infrastructure.

GET

List Supported Banks

Returns a list of all supported Nigerian banks with their codes. Use the code value when calling the verify endpoint.

GET/banks
curl -X GET https://api.vtstack.ng/api/banks \
  -H "x-api-key: YOUR_SECRET_KEY"

Success Response

Example Request
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    { "code": "100033", "name": "PalmPay" },
    { "code": "044", "name": "Access Bank" },
    { "code": "058", "name": "Guaranty Trust Bank" },
    { "code": "033", "name": "United Bank for Africa" },
    { "code": "057", "name": "Zenith Bank" }
  ]
}
GET

Verify Bank Account

Performs a Name Enquiry — resolves an account number to the registered account holder name. Pass the bankCode and accountNumber as query parameters.

ParameterTypeDescription
bankCodestring (Req)The bank code from the List Banks endpoint (e.g. "044" for Access Bank).
accountNumberstring (Req)The 10-digit NUBAN account number to verify.

Example Request

GET/banks/verify?bankCode=044&accountNumber=0123456789
curl -X GET "https://api.vtstack.ng/api/banks/verify?bankCode=044&accountNumber=0123456789" \
  -H "x-api-key: YOUR_SECRET_KEY"

Success Response

Example Request
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "accountName": "HASSAN IBRAHIM",
    "accountNumber": "0123456789",
    "bankCode": "044"
  }
}

Error Response

Example Request
// 400 — Missing parameters
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "bankCode and accountNumber are required"
}

// 400 — Invalid account
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Bank resolution failed"
}

Integration Tip

Always verify the account name with your user before proceeding with a transfer. Display the resolved accountName and ask for explicit confirmation to prevent wrong-account payouts.

Webhooks

Webhooks are used to notify your server of events. We send a POST request to your configured URL when a deposit is received.

Signature Verification

Ensure your server validates the X-VTStack-Signature header using your webhook secret to prevent spoofing calls.

Example Request
{
  "event": "transaction.deposit",
  "data": {
    "reference": "TXN_7726182",
    "amount": 5000,
    "currency": "NGN",
    "customer": { "name": "Hassan Ibrahim" },
    "timestamp": "2026-03-20T14:30:00Z"
  }
}

Errors & Handling

Our API returns standard HTTP status codes. Errors are always returned in a JSON format for easy parsing.

CodeMeaningDescription
400Bad RequestRequired parameters are missing or invalid.
401UnauthorizedInvalid or missing API key.
422Validation ErrorBVN verification failed or duplicate account found.
429Too Many RequestsYour platform has exceeded the rate limit.
500Server ErrorSomething went wrong on our end.

Best Practices

Key Management

Never hardcode your API keys. Use environment variables and store them in vault systems like Hashicorp Vault or AWS Secrets Manager.

Idempotency

Always use unique reference strings for account creation to avoid creating duplicate accounts for the same user on retries.
